title: Hearty Homemade Canadian Tempeh Hash
description: A fermented, crumbly, and cozy Canadian dish made with tempeh, featuring sunflower oil and a bain-marie cooking method, perfect for a flexitarian-friendly meal. This dish is a hearty and satisfying option for any time of day.
instructions: Heat the sunflower oil in a wok over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the diced bell pepper and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Add the crumbled tempeh and cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the diced potatoes, salt, black pepper, and smoked paprika, and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Use a bain-marie to keep the hash warm while serving.
Serve the hash hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
